name: ThunderHub
description: ThunderHub is an open-source Lightning Network node manager with a browser interface for monitoring and managing LND or Lightning Terminal nodes, channels, payments, on-chain wallet activity, Taproot Assets, swaps, and multi-node accounts.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Stores ThunderHub account config, optional cookie, and optional SQLite database files.

paths.name: LND Data
paths.description: Optional read-only mount for an LND data directory. YAML accounts can use lndDir: /lnd.

paths.name: LiTD Data
paths.description: Optional read-only mount for a Lightning Terminal data directory. YAML accounts can use litDir: /lit.

variables.name: Host
variables.description: Interface ThunderHub listens on inside the container.

variables.name: Account Config Path
variables.description: Path to the ThunderHub YAML account config inside the container. ThunderHub can create this file if the Data path is writable.

variables.name: Master Password Override
variables.description: Optional password override used for all YAML accounts.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Logging level, for example error, warn, info, debug, or verbose.

variables.name: Theme
variables.description: Default interface theme. Use dark or light.

variables.name: Currency
variables.description: Default currency display, for example sat, btc, or usd.

variables.name: Mempool URL
variables.description: Mempool API base URL used for fee and block data.

variables.name: Tor Proxy
variables.description: Optional SOCKS proxy used for outbound connections, for example socks://127.0.0.1:9050.

variables.name: Fetch Prices
variables.description: Fetch exchange price data. Set to false to disable.

variables.name: Fetch Fees
variables.description: Fetch fee recommendation data. Set to false to disable.

variables.name: Disable External Links
variables.description: Disable external links in the interface. Use true or false.

variables.name: Disable Version Check
variables.description: Disable checks against the latest GitHub release. Use true or false.

variables.name: Disable All Subscriptions
variables.description: Disable all Lightning realtime subscriptions. Use true or false.

variables.name: SSO Server URL
variables.description: Optional SSO node gRPC address, for example 192.168.1.10:10009 or lnd:10009.

variables.name: SSO Certificate Path
variables.description: Optional SSO TLS certificate path inside the container, for example /lnd/tls.cert.

variables.name: SSO Macaroon Directory
variables.description: Optional directory containing admin.macaroon for SSO, for example /lnd/data/chain/bitcoin/mainnet.

variables.name: SSO Node Type
variables.description: SSO node type. Use lnd or litd.

variables.name: Dangerous No SSO Auth
variables.description: Allow SSO without auth. Only use behind trusted access controls. Use true or false.

variables.name: Cookie Path
variables.description: Optional persistent cookie secret path. Keep this in the Data path if enabled.

variables.name: YAML Env 1
variables.description: Optional value that can be referenced from thubConfig.yaml as {YML_ENV_1}.

variables.name: YAML Env 2
variables.description: Optional value that can be referenced from thubConfig.yaml as {YML_ENV_2}.

variables.name: YAML Env 3
variables.description: Optional secret value that can be referenced from thubConfig.yaml as {YML_ENV_3}.

variables.name: YAML Env 4
variables.description: Optional value that can be referenced from thubConfig.yaml as {YML_ENV_4}.

variables.name: Database Type
variables.description: Optional database backend. Leave blank to disable, or use sqlite or postgres.

variables.name: SQLite Database Path
variables.description: SQLite database path used when Database Type is sqlite.

variables.name: Postgres URL
variables.description: Postgres connection URL used when Database Type is postgres.

variables.name: Database Encryption Key
variables.description: Optional 64-character hex key for encrypting node credentials at rest.
